claims.statement: The WAKE architecture defines its own operational logic and trust boundaries through documented specifications.

claims.statement: WAKE maintains a strict separation between model-authored research requests and verified source evidence to ensure inquiry integrity.

support.explanation: Research code defines the boundary where model questions (requests) are distinguished from actual evidence sources.
support.passage: # RESEARCH — the trusted collector boundary. Model-authored research requests are questions, not evidence.
